title: A clone does not inherit the first operator's consent
statement: A project carrying a committed research choice, opened on a machine with no local consent record, reopens the prompt and does not use that host's credential until it is answered. Changing the provider or the research choice likewise reopens the relevant prompt.
notes: ⚠️ NOT EVALUATED, 2026-09-22. EVD-0126 is component proof for TSK-0034: clone controls for project-local and per-user state, negative controls for a force-added record (R1), a staged but uncommitted removal (R5) and an unignored record in a parent repository (R6), and the no-Git limit (R4). This criterion is evaluated once the research choice writer (TSK-0035), the model selection writer and their clearGrants calls, and the launch path are connected, because the choice-change clause depends on writers that do not exist yet.
